card.name: Modifiers before Nazi-era military terms
card.fires_on: Adjectives or names of sides such as White, German, Soviet, Nazi, placed right before army, party, or similar nouns in World War and Nazi-era history text.

modes.label: Nation or side before a force
modes.description: A nationality or faction word comes just before army, division, or air force.
modes.example: Hitler volunteered for service in the<< German>> army and was accepted into the infantry.

modes.label: Nazi party naming
modes.description: Words inside or leading into Nazi party names and terms.
modes.example: The party's name was changed to the National Socialist<< German>> Workers Party (NAZI) on

modes.label: Possessive or linking word
modes.description: A linking word after a country or book title in Nazi-era text.
modes.example: Italy's army and Germany<<'s>> air force, the Luftwaffe.

card.plain: It marks words like German, Soviet, or Nazi in World War II history, just before a noun like army or party.
